faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. Weekend support is available for enterprise clients only.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', and enter your email. You'll receive a reset link within 5 minutes.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex), PayPal, and wire transfers for annual contracts.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Yes, full refunds within 14 days of purchase. No refunds after 14 days.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email support@techsupport.com or call 1-800-555-0123 during business hours.

faqs.question: What is your pricing?
faqs.answer: Basic plan: $29/month. Pro plan: $99/month. Enterprise: Custom pricing.

faqs.question: Do you have a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes, 14-day free trial with full features. No credit card required.

policies.sla: 99.9% uptime guarantee for Pro and Enterprise plans
policies.data_retention: Customer data retained for 1 year after account closure
policies.security: SOC2 Type II certified, data encrypted at rest and in transit
